svg.title: R53 Gaussian REML local influence numerical acceptance map
svg.desc: Four independently generated Gaussian primitive blocks, ordinary and extreme leverage paired within block. Ordinary leverage: block 3 only smooth-interior accepted, blocks 0-2 refused near participant-slope variance box boundary. Extreme leverage: blocks 1-3 smooth-interior accepted, block 0 refused near boundary. All 8 original REML fits accepted numerically. Among 4 accepted local derivatives, 12 of 12 weighted-response perturbation directions and all 24 plus-minus refits passed. Twelve of 24 planned directions not attempted because interior conditions refused. Median physical nuisance directional Jacobian relative discrepancy 0.000826 and pivot derivative absolute discrepancy 0.000379 across all accepted directions. No global coverage qualification.
svg.text: R53 · Interior Gaussian nuisance influence is selective
Original independent Gaussian source: four primitive blocks × paired predictor leverage conditions
32/32 original and attempted perturbation covariance fits accepted
8 original fits accepted · 4/8 eligible for local influence · 12/24 directions attempted
24/24 plus/minus refits successful · 12/24 directions excluded before perturbation
Accepted directions: median nuisance derivative relative discrepancy 0.000825
Median studentized pivot derivative absolute discrepancy 0.000379
Local smooth-root numerical agreement only; boundary inference, coverage, simultaneous bands and release remain unqualified.
